title: Echoes of Them — Official Support, Terms & Privacy
heroDesc: Crafting intimate, secure tools to preserve life's fleeting moments and voices before they fade away.
featTableDesc: Place the device flat on the table, enter Table Mode, and look into each other's eyes while talking. The software stays quietly in the background.
featNoAiTitle: Strictly Zero Biometric AI & No Voice Cloning
featNoAiDesc: The human voice is treated as a sacred, irreproducible treasure. Strictly zero voice cloning, synthesis, AI transcription APIs, or biometric cloud uploads. 100% offline.
featCapsuleDesc: Encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 and a key derived from your password with Argon2id (libsodium), with Zstandard level 9 compression for metadata. Keys live in protected memory and are wiped after use.
featHtmlPlayerDesc: Export an autonomous, self-contained HTML player alongside standard Ogg Opus audio. Works directly via file:// in any browser without internet or external servers for decades.
featNoGameDesc: Curated invitation card decks across 10 languages. Any question can be passed gently without pressure or guilt. Zero completion percentages or anxiety loops.
featDesktopDesc: Built with Compose Multiplatform for Android, Windows, and Linux. Full visual and cryptographic parity between your phone and your desktop computer.
privMicDesc: Echoes of Them requests access to your microphone strictly when you deliberately tap to record an oral memory or interview in Table Mode. The microphone is never activated in the background or without your explicit, visible consent.
privStorageDesc: All audio recordings are encoded into standard RFC 7845 Ogg Opus files and stored solely within your device's private sandbox (and sealed within your encrypted .echoes capsules). No voice recordings are ever uploaded to cloud servers, shared with third parties, or used for biometric profiling.
privControlDesc: You retain complete custody of your archive: you can revoke microphone access at any time through system settings and permanently delete any voice recording or person profile directly inside the application.
tierOneTimeDesc: Your name is inscribed on the Wall of Fame (inside the app's About screen) and you can propose meaningful invitation prompt cards for upcoming deck updates.
tierMonthlyDesc: Your name honored on the Wall of Fame with a personalized reflective dedication under it, propose priority conversation cards, and actively vote on future multiplatform roadmap milestones.
disclaimer_desc: Color schemes, reflective prompts, and soundtrack references are cultural and artistic homages inspired by their respective original masterworks. All intellectual property rights belong entirely to their original authors, composers, and animation studios. Echoes of Them is an independent, non-commercial, artisanal project.
support_desc: Echoes of Them is part of Evanescent Echo, a small suite of free, private tools, with no cloud and no AI. If you believe in preserving human voices, you can support Evanescent Echo and all its tools on Ko-fi.
footprintTitle: Leave Your Mark on Echoes of Them

projectDesc1: Echoes of Them is a 100% offline oral archive designed to capture the authentic voices, laughter, and personal stories of the people we cherish before time slips away.
projectInspirationDesc: The philosophy and aesthetic of Echoes of Them are deeply rooted in the bittersweet beauty of impermanence (Mono no Aware). In a world rushing toward synthetic voice cloning and impersonal clouds, Echoes of Them celebrates the irreducible warmth of an unedited human conversation.
quoteText: "A human voice is not data to be cloned or synthesized; it is the unique, unrepeatable vibration of a soul we love, captured before the silence falls."

projectTechDesc1: Built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform, and the shared Evanescent Echo security library (libsodium with a C++17 layer). Uses RFC 7845 compliant Ogg Opus audio containers for universal standard compatibility.
projectTechDesc2: No user accounts, no telemetry tokens, and zero servers. Sealed capsules (.echoes) can only be decrypted with your chosen password, through Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305.
faqCapsuleTitle: What is the .echoes sealed capsule format?
faqCapsuleDesc: The .echoes format is a sovereign, tamper-resistant archive. It packs metadata, person profiles, waveform peaks, and audio tracks, compresses the metadata with Zstandard level 9, and encrypts everything with XChaCha20-Poly1305 using a key derived from your master password with Argon2id. Any tampering is detected, and only the master password can open it.
faqHtmlTitle: How does the 40+ year HTML Player export work?
faqHtmlDesc: When exporting an open capsule, the app produces a self-contained index.html alongside pure .opus files. It contains embedded CSS and vanilla JavaScript with zero CDN or external dependencies, opening directly via file:// in any browser today or decades from now.
faqTableDesc: Table Mode is a dual-orientation interface designed for intimacy. Place the phone flat between two people: one side displays the invitation card right-side up for the speaker, while the other side allows subtle control without taking attention away from eye contact.
faqVoiceTitle: Does Echoes of Them use AI to synthesize or clone voices?
faqVoiceDesc: Never. Echoes of Them has a strict philosophical boundary: zero voice cloning, zero generative AI, and zero biometric profiling. Audio recorded is treated with sacred respect and remains 100% human and unmanipulated.
faqDesktopTitle: How does the Desktop version work (Windows & Linux)?
faqDesktopDesc: Echoes of Them Desktop provides full parity with mobile: offline architecture, native C++17 security bindings, full .echoes capsule compatibility, and comfortable long-form listening on your PC.
privSec1Body: Echoes of Them is strictly offline-first. I do not collect, transmit, sell, or analyze personal data, voice files, or databases with external servers or third parties. All oral archives remain exclusively on your local device in encrypted storage. This website is purely informative and uses no tracking cookies or telemetry.
privSec2Body: The core application requires no active network (Internet) permissions. Your recordings cannot be accessed or leaked across telecommunication networks.
privSec3Body: My commitment to zero cloud data collection and zero biometric processing is permanent. Any minor legal wording updates will be documented here transparently.
privSec4Body: If you have inquiries regarding privacy or archival preservation, contact: support.evanescentecho@gmail.com.
termsSec1Body: By using Echoes of Them, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you disagree with any terms, please discontinue using the application.
termsSec2Body: The application is distributed as a privacy-respecting tool without commercial monetization or data harvesting. Theme names and musical references represent cultural homages without claiming ownership of third-party intellectual property.
termsSec3Body: The author provides the client software but maintains no access or backdoors to your encrypted data. Users are solely responsible for safely preserving their master passwords and backing up their .echoes files.
termsSec4Body: The application is provided "as is", without warranties of uninterrupted operation or defect-free service.
